title: Unused gleam/option import in draft integration test (compiler warning)
detail: Line 10 imports gleam/option but no `option.` reference appears anywhere in the 572-line file (grep for 'option.' returns nothing). Gleam emits an unused-import warning on every test build; the import is dead weight.

title: Resume-page backdate test fails spuriously if >1s elapses between its two clock reads
detail: view_resume_page stamps now-10_000ms (form_pages.gleam:431). `v < before` holds only while the render's internal current_unix_ms() runs <1000ms after line 344's read; a >1s scheduler stall between them fails the test despite correct code. No tolerance or relative-delta assertion guards the boundary.
recommended_fix: Assert a relative window instead, e.g. capture `after = form_view.current_unix_ms()` post-render and check `v <= after - 10_000` plus `v >= before - 10_000`, so the assertion is independent of inter-call elapsed time.
